title: Ingest the iHRIS Administrator Handbook (mwlib wiki export)
description: Verifies the uploaded PDF's sha256, runs folio-assistant's pdf-structure and pdf-images rungs, and writes library/ihris-admin-handbook/: one Markdown section per wiki article (with its wiki revision and contributors), the images, book.json (ihris-wiki-book/v1: articles, image credits matched by order of appearance, licences, redactions) and manifest.jsonld. Real e-mail addresses and phone numbers are redacted. Deterministic; rewrites its own output.
